intro.text: Evi's brother, a Riran lighteyes who comes to the Kholins with her.
Evi's brother, a Riran lighteyes and Dalinar Kholin's brother-in-law.

items.text: Toh grew up in Rira with his sister Evi, who was given Shardplate in her youth. In their late teens they fled with the Plate, to their relatives' anger, and offered it to the Alethi in exchange for asylum. Toh negotiated with Gavilar Kholin, his doubts about Alethi protection eased by meeting Dalinar. Ialai Sadeas suggested Dalinar marry Evi to seal the deal.

Toh used Riran customs to drag out the betrothal, trying to add clauses to the contract, such as joining House Kholin's royal line. Once Dalinar won Kalanor's Blade and Plate, Gavilar would allow no more delay, and Dalinar married Evi in exchange for her Plate. Toh and Evi both gained significant status.

Toh lived in Kholinar with Evi for a time, adopting Alethi fashion. He disliked Dalinar's visits to firemoss dens. He was there when Evi gave birth to Adolin, and brought the news to Dalinar. Afterwards he moved to the coast of Herdaz, where he lived under the protection of Alethi bodyguards for at least a decade.

appearance.text: A tall, slender, even spindly lighteyed man with golden hair and skin lighter than most Alethi, he walks with a delicate gait and would never be mistaken for a soldier. He speaks Alethi with a thick accent, though not as thick as Evi's.

personality.text: Careful and overly cautious, he can seem innocent and naive, and talks a lot when nervous. Dalinar first takes him for a sycophant, while Gavilar and Ialai think him genuine but desperate. He admires Alethi history, especially the Sunmaker, and is curious about how the Alethi wage war.
